rationale: Both Sylvester and Pranesh are deeply focused on cybersecurity, but from complementary angles—Sylvester as a security-focused student exploring the field, and Pranesh as a Software Engineer at Palo Alto Networks working on ML and agentic AI systems in cybersecurity and healthcare.
